correctness.rationale: Cauchy-Crofton line measure normalizes by polygon perimeter 2nR sin(pi/n). The regular-n-gon support h(theta)=R cos t on each vertex Voronoi cell yields the displayed two-branch F_n exactly, including r<=0 and r>=R. For beta=pi/n, when beta<=alpha=arccos(r/R), F=r beta/(R sin beta); when beta>alpha, F=1+[(r/R)alpha-sin alpha]/sin beta. Both are strictly increasing in beta and meet at alpha, yielding F_n strictly decreasing in n for every 0<r<R and limit r/R. Differentiating establishes C1/not-C2 inradius contact, second derivatives 0 and -1/(R^2 sin^2 beta), and 3/2 circumradius tail. Independent fresh support-angle midpoint integrals agreed for 25 (n,r) pairs to <3e-6; finite numerical checks are corroboration, not proof.
